source: studio ID photo supplied by the subject
photo_type: formal identification photo, single colour background

subject.framing: head and shoulders; the head occupies roughly the upper half of the frame
subject.pose: front-facing, square to the camera, head level
subject.expression: neutral with a very slight smile, mouth closed

technical.crop: tight ID-photo crop, the shoulder line is partially cut
